mission.title: Rotten Fruit

npc.say: Lookit me, I'm a monster made out of flies! Buzz, buzz!
I ain't got time to give you the story of my life, kid. Well, okay, maybe I got the time, but you don't.

Look, we get nuts, punks, drunks, felons, pimps, cops, bleeding-hearts, and public housing officials around here, but no trenchcoat-wearing guys in hockey masks. I think you've been watching a little too much TV.
I wish you'd do something about those helicopters. Sure is hard to sleep with them buzzing around all night.

Be careful; he lives in a pit of intense decay. Death gives him power. You cannot take him by surprise, and my husband will do everything he can to protect him. You must be strong, my hero--strong, and very brave.

phase.briefing: While production of flit guns proceeds apace, we have no hope of destroying the Assassin if we can't find him. He has thus far proven highly elusive. But statistical analysis of his known appearances has begun to indicate a pattern: he seems to favor areas in the slums, near the river. Since the Assassin disappears for extended periods of time, Commander Lock suspects that he may have a hideout or bolt-hole somewhere along the slum riverfront. Warrior, if you can find his den, the Assassin will soon fall into Zion's hands. Begin by investigating a certain derelict area in the slums, near the center of the Assassin sightings.

enter.say: That's the place you're supposed to check for flies. You brought your bug spray, right? I got a suspicion that we're gonna need it.
I'm scanning four bluepills in that area. Talk to them and see if they've got any information about the Assassin.

talk.say: Flies? Sure, I got plenty of flies. Take all you want!
I've seen plenty of stuff that would rattle your silver spoons, kiddo. Trust me, you're better off not knowin'.
Assassin? Does he fly around in a black helicopter? There've been some of those around here.

complete.say: Seems like that area's clean. I hope Tyndall has another idea.

phase.briefing: I fear that finding the Assassin may be more difficult than we had thought. I'm going to send you to an area of Exile activity--we believe that these Exiles, in particular, are close to the center of the Merovingian's organization. If you can't find anything in the area itself, try interrogating one of the Exiles; they may know something about the Assassin's movements.

enter.say: That's the spot. Looks like Tyndall was right this time: I'm picking up Exile programs in there.

talk.say: Hah! You don't scare me, pus-bag--not while Stevie is around to protect me! You'd have to show me her still-beating heart to make me talk!
Stevie's "still-beating heart"? Alejandro has quite an imagination. But maybe he knows something useful about the Assassin. If only there were a way to make him talk...

done.say: Qu'est-ce que c'est? A human? How quaint!
Ewww! I can't believe you just did that!
Sounds like we aren't going to get anything out of that bunch after all. We'll never find the Assassin's lair at this rate.

Noooo! Stevie! You...you animal! She was beautiful, and you've ruined her! We don't know anything about the damned Assassin! You think the Merovingian tells us where his pet lives? To hell with both of them!

phase.briefing: Warrior, we've just received an encrypted message on a high-frequency channel, source unknown. The message mentions you specifically, and says that you will find information on the Assassin at a certain address nearby. This is highly irregular, and probably a trap. Under normal circumstances I would never ask you to go into such a dangerous situation, but...we seem to be out of options. I'm sending the address to you now. Be careful, {player}. We don't know what may be waiting for you there.

enter.say: That's the place. There's some kind of...really strong jammer or something--I can't get a clear reading on the interior. Whoever's in there must have access to top-level hacks. This could be bad.

talk.say: Oh no. No way. It can't be her... Oh, crap.

I have been waiting for you. Are you familiar with Homer, soldier? Odysseus' lover, a witch, told him to seek the gates of the underworld near "the groves of Persephone." You wish to eliminate this Satan, this...Assassin, do you not? I hate him--I want him dead. You will be my Odysseus--my hero. I will show you the way. I have what you seek.

done.say: Take this, please. It is what you wanted.

phase.briefing: I don't like this, Warrior; I don't like having to trust that woman. But for now, at least, it seems that we have no choice. The address she gave you is in an area for which we have surprisingly little data. I'm not sure what Persephone expects you to find there; we can only hope that you will find some clue to the location of the Assassin's den.

enter.say: I'm reading plenty of Exile programs in there. There also seems to be some sort of closed network, with protocols that I haven't seen before.
Looks like they've got network trouble.
You're getting closer to the network interface I detected earlier. Something's weird with it though--the signal is sporadic.

done.say: There's the network interface: a hardline junction box. Looks like some of the wires have been cut. If you can fix it, maybe we can figure out what it's connected to.
Whoa! Data spike. One of the computers in that area must be getting a feed from that junction box. If you can find that computer, we can try analyzing the data.
Ooh--those are some tasty-looking ones and zeroes. Get that stuff uploaded at a hardline.

objective.text: Upload the data at a hardline

mission.finish: The data you captured from the repaired hardline node contained information on a hidden hardline network. One of its terminals appears to be located on a garbage barge in the middle of the river--a "pit of intense decay" indeed. You have discovered the Assassin's base of operations, Warrior; now Zion must smoke him out.
